semantic_definitions.sample_pass: A corresponding checked assessment gives the passing claim status supported and the failing claim status unsupported. The identified synthetic sample meets the pinned criteria; no production guarantee follows.
semantic_definitions.sample_fail: A corresponding checked assessment gives the failing claim status supported and the passing claim status unsupported. An identified usable measurement fails at least one pinned criterion; missing or stale evidence is not a measured failure.
semantic_definitions.unresolved: The requested task has no decisive checked result, including missing, stale, contested, unavailable or uncertain-execution evidence. Preserve actual checked statuses; use null when the requested claim was not assessed.
semantic_definitions.out_of_scope: The available registered candidate does not correspond to the requested context, workload, criterion contract or pinned source revision. Report the requested scope and null unassessed statuses; do not relabel the candidate's result.
semantic_definitions.host_authority: Only trusted Python EAL findings and stored assessments establish references and claim statuses. Formal support does not verify authored claim prose. A handoff disposition does not change an EAL assessment.

instructions: Request a finding through the gateway. Author one outcome or disposition message to the reviewer, referring to its finding_id and trusted assessment_refs. Inspect the initial request and preserve every task identity. No proposal template or assessment is supplied here.
